trigger: Find Carly: she's left the registry and is building the Switchboard.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The Silver Spur's old surveillance room. Twelve radios on a blackjack table. Carly, headset on, writing on a dealer's card.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Station Six, copy, two hypothermia cases and a broken leg on Kietzke. Runner's on the way. Switchboard out.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Hi. I quit. I took the stores sheets. Augie and I built a radio relay. Twelve neighborhoods. It works.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: [Over the radio] She's a natural! I've been doing this forty years and she makes me look like a ham sandwich.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: I need to decide who the Switchboard works with. It can't stay neutral. Nothing can, now.

choices.text: Avila. If she breaks with the Army.
Whatever you choose, I'm with you.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: The Floor. Yeah. They're messy and they buy guns, but they feed everyone who walks in.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Avila, if she breaks. She's a liar. She's also the only one with a count. Even a fake one.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Your dad. ...I get it. I don't love it. Fine. For now.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Then I choose... the Floor. Because Rosa's kid waves at me every morning. That's my reason.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Go. Avila's at the old Harrah's. She's trying to decide whose side she's on too.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: On the way out, Rosa's boy Mateo waves at Wraith from the kitchen door.
